I am applying for the Senior Site Reliability Engineer role at Cloudhaven.
Cloudhaven's developer platform serving 900 engineering teams is exactly the kind of scale I work on.

I'm applying for the {role} position at {company}.

Working with commercial teams at Northgate Retail also showed me how much impact comes from presenting results clearly, from automating weekly trading reports to running A/B tests reaching 450,000 customers.
I'd welcome the chance to talk about how I can help.

I have eight years of experience teaching English at secondary and upper-secondary level, and I work hard to combine a communicative approach with digital tools.
